name: Myogadani
tagline: Otemachi in 11 minutes and Tokyo in 13 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Bunkyo City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 11 minutes to Otemachi, 19 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 27 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 26.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 9.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 26.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 18.2 m to 27.6 m, a difference of 9.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 6 clinics and 2 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 小石川東京病院, about 13 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京健生病院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000 and 2LDK ¥250,000 to ¥260,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station and little daily shopping within walking distance. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Edogawabashi is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is, but Myogadani is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Myogadani. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Myogadani.
